commands.name: ping
commands.summary: Check bridge responsiveness without changing agent handoff state.
commands.result: Empty result object; standard envelope echoes the request ID and includes frame/playbackFrame/structureVersion.
commands.effects: No command-specific mutation. Reaches the editor frame queue.
commands.completion: Immediate once serviced on the main thread.

commands.name: setAgentState
commands.summary: Set the diagnostic agent busy/ready indicator.

arguments.name: state
arguments.description: Exact values busy, ready, or empty string; uppercase variants are invalid.

commands.result: Object with state equal to the accepted string.
commands.effects: Changes transient agent indicator and note. Any other command except ping changes ready to busy; there is no separate read-state command.

commands.name: getVersion
commands.summary: Report assembly version and bridge protocol version.
commands.result: Object with protocolVersion (integer, currently 1) and editorVersion (assembly version string, nullable). Assembly version is not exact commit identity.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from the shared agent-ready handoff rule.

commands.name: getPaths
commands.summary: Report the running editor's actual profile and project paths.
commands.result: Object with absolute settings, temp, cache, projects paths; log is nullable if no log writer exists. Projects is the default project root, not a list of loaded projects.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff.

commands.name: shutdown
commands.summary: Request application exit, discarding unsaved project edits.
commands.result: An empty success result is sent before requesting exit; connection teardown may prevent the caller receiving it.
commands.effects: Exits TiXL. Unsaved edits are discarded; normal exit may persist user settings. Use only an owned session in tests.
commands.completion: Reply may race teardown; verify owned process exit separately.

commands.name: getStructureVersion
commands.result: Object with symbolStructureVersion integer. This differs from the envelope's structureVersion UI counter and is not an exact package/build identity.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff.

commands.name: getLogTail
commands.summary: Read buffered log entries with sequence cursors.

arguments.name: sinceSeq
arguments.description: Return entries with seq greater than this cursor. Negative means newest window; stale cursor starts at oldest retained entry.

arguments.name: maxCount
arguments.description: Maximum entries. Nonpositive returns no entries. Buffer retains 4096 records; newest-window selection occurs before level filtering.

arguments.name: minLevel
arguments.description: Case-insensitive debug/info/warning/warn/error; unknown strings fall back to debug.

commands.result: Object with entries array, latestSeq, oldestAvailableSeq. Entry fields: seq integer, time HH:mm:ss.fff, level string, message string, sourceId GUID string or null. Old records can roll out.
commands.effects: Allocates response from in-memory ring buffer. Does not clear logs.

commands.name: getContext
commands.summary: Inspect focused composition, selection, time, and primary output view.
commands.result: Always hasOpenProject boolean and time object (timeInBars,timeInSecs,playbackSpeed,isPlaying,bpm). With a focused composition: compositionSymbolId,compositionName,compositionPath string array,selectedChildren [{childId,name}]. Optional outputView contains isPinned and, if resolvable, childId,symbolName,path.
commands.effects: Read only, apart from shared agent-ready handoff. Child IDs are composition-scoped.

commands.name: getMetrics
commands.summary: Read timing, memory, render statistics, and resource counters.
commands.result: Numeric fields frameDeltaSeconds,fps,framePeriodMs,refreshRateHz,visualDeltaMs,vblanksPerFrame,frameSpeedFactor,gpuFrameMs,queuedFrames,gcTotalMemoryMb,stateStackDepth,liveGpuResources; presentationMode string; renderStats object. gpuMemory is null when unavailable, otherwise currentUsageMb,budgetMb and optionally resourceMb.
commands.effects: Queries backend/DXGI memory and allocates a result; repeated calls are not a zero-cost idle measurement.
commands.completion: Immediate; device queries can incur work.

commands.name: getShaderErrors
commands.summary: Read shader compilation failures or clear them.

arguments.name: clear
arguments.description: When true, clears the failure list and returns immediately, ignoring includeSource.

arguments.name: includeSource
arguments.description: Attempt to read each available sourcePath file. Adds source text or sourceError per entry; missing sourcePath adds neither.

commands.result: Clear variant: {cleared:true}. Read variant: {count,failures:[{time,name,entryPoint,reason,ownerPath,ownerId,sourcePath,sourceLineCount,source?,sourceError?}]}; newest first.
commands.effects: clear mutates recorded failures. includeSource reads files and can enlarge the response.
commands.completion: Immediate; source reads happen on the main thread.

commands.name: getFrameSamples
commands.summary: Read the performance window's ordered timing samples.
commands.result: Object with totalFrames integer and frameMs,cpuMs,presentMs numeric arrays, each oldest first. Series are recorded independently and may have different lengths during warmup; do not zip them as synchronized samples. Durations are rounded to two decimal places.
commands.effects: Allocates arrays and response JSON on explicit request; avoid polling for idle profiling.

commands.name: stallMainThread
commands.summary: Intentionally block the editor frame thread.

arguments.name: estimateKey
arguments.description: Nonempty value wraps work in MainThreadActivity for estimated-progress UI.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Message used by the activity wrapper.

commands.effects: Blocks rendering and UI; logs a debug entry. Tests use bounded short stalls in fresh owned sessions.
commands.completion: Deferred by synchronous sleep; not cancellable by client timeout.

commands.name: setVSync
commands.summary: Report or set the VSync preference.

arguments.name: value
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.effects: A supplied non-null value changes user settings, normally persisted on exit; it is a preference, not a guarantee of presentation behavior.
commands.completion: Immediate setting update; rendering applies the preference subsequently.

commands.name: releaseGpuResources
commands.summary: Request release of cached GPU resources.
commands.result: Empty result object acknowledges the release request.
commands.effects: Schedules GPU resource release for the start of the next frame; active resources can be recreated. Does not promise all GPU memory becomes zero.
commands.completion: Acknowledgement precedes release. Pump a frame before inspecting effects.

commands.name: setTargetFrameRate
commands.summary: Report or set the target frame-rate preference.

arguments.name: value
arguments.description: Non-null values clamp to >=0. Zero renders every refresh.
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.effects: Changes user settings when a value is supplied; normally persisted on exit. Hardware and rendering determine achieved rate.

commands.name: setFrameLatency
commands.summary: Report or set the number of frames in flight.

arguments.name: value
arguments.omissionBehavior: Report only. Explicit JSON null is different: conversion fails with INTERNAL_ERROR.

commands.effects: Changes user settings when supplied; normally persisted on exit. Backend determines actual presentation behavior.
